abstract: Covers the GraphQL specification from the GraphQL Foundation, pinned to the September 2025 edition: the language (documents, operations, selection sets, fields, arguments, aliases, fragments, variables, directives, descriptions, schema coordinates), the type system (scalars, objects, interfaces, unions, enums, input objects with @oneOf, lists, non-null, @deprecated, @specifiedBy), introspection, validation, execution with value completion and null propagation, and the data, errors and extensions response. It also covers the GraphQL over HTTP Stage 2 draft as a separate family with a build posture. It lists six lines: September 2025 (current), October 2021 (supported), June 2018 and October 2016 and earlier (legacy), the working draft (preview, track), and the GraphQL over HTTP draft (current, build). SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions and upgrades, language and types, validation and execution, introspection and errors, and GraphQL over HTTP.
